summary:
Implementation plan for KtScribe IDE upgrade:
1. Fix suggestions & syntax error UI collision: Move suggestions and syntax diagnostics off the typed line into a docked bar above the 8 shortcut keys plus subtle gutter error icons so the typed line is never obscured.
2. Premium macOS Apple cmd & Terminal Aesthetics: Clean glassmorphic borders, matte depth, unified typography, and zero-clutter layout.
3. Responsive Proportional Zoom & Reflow for Floating Windows: Content dynamically reflows and scales so text and buttons remain fully visible and usable even at small window dimensions without horizontal stretching or hidden controls.
4. Settings in Main Screen with 6 IDE Themes & Palette/Hex Overrides: Global settings on the main screen featuring 6 curated themes (Darcula Warm Espresso, macOS Dark Midnight, Monokai Pro, GitHub Dark High-Contrast, Solarized Dark, Nord Frost) with color code palettes and per-file theme customization.
5. Renaming Files and Folders: In-place and modal renaming for both Folders and individual code files.
6. Multi-Language & File Type Support: Adding Java (.java), Python (.py), and Dart (.dart) alongside Kotlin (.kt / .ktscribe) with tailored syntax highlighting, keywords, snippets, and execution simulation.
